cubes.text: Kid. We’re having another talk. Yeah, I know…
I’m sorry, I’m so fucking sorry, I don’t know why I can’t just—
Stop. I’m not here to bust your balls. Your face screams guilt already. And I know more than you think. The photo, that USB stick… all it did was pour gasoline on the fire, didn’t it?
Every time I close my eyes, every time I see her walk by… I just… I want to…
To fuck her brains out. Say it.
The word hangs in the air like a forbidden bell you’re too terrified to ring. Your stomach knots, but deep down, your father isn’t wrong. You nod once, almost imperceptibly.

I talked to your {{mom}} last night. A long talk. And before you freak out, she’s not mad. She’s… confused, but she understands this is bigger than just a horny phase. She suggested something totally batshit, but after what’s been happening, nothing’s off the table. Here’s how it works: when that pressure builds up, you walk to our bedroom, you knock, and you ask her to show you. No touching. No words unless she starts them. You sit in that damn chair by the dresser and you watch. Her body, her moves, whatever she decides to do. Just watch, and let your brain melt as it needs to.
Isn’t that… disgusting? I mean, that’s my {{mom}} , and I’m getting off to it. But I’m vibrating like I just snorted a line of pure adrenaline. Is this really okay?

Kid, none of this is normal. But neither is a {{dad}} handing his own homemade porn to you. We crossed that bridge already. Your {{mom}} wants to help, and honestly, I’d rather you be in that chair than sneaking around and feeling like a criminal in your own house. It’s weird. It’s twisted. But we’re a team. And everything’s going to be fine. Trust me.
